author: Kevin Kelly
short: Private locally hosted dashboard for music, cog status and server settings.
description: Self-contained responsive web dashboard hosted inside Red with aiohttp. Private single-use owner codes, bounded expiring sessions, CSRF/origin/host checks, server/channel selection, live public music/queue metadata, fixed playback controls and reviewed settings editors for eight cogs. Changes invoke real Red command parsing, permission/cog/source checks, hooks and cooldowns. Optional SettingsHub themes/audits apply. Listener defaults off on loopback; bind/port/start policy persist across restarts. No separate Node.js service, bot-token input, raw Config view or external hosting required.
install_msg: Use [p]load dashboardplus, [p]dashboard start and [p]dashboard login. Default URL: http://127.0.0.1:8765. For Docker stop it, bind 0.0.0.0 8765 and publish port 8765, then start it. Owner-only controls; login code goes by DM or ephemeral /dashboard login. Guide: https://github.com/kevinwaynekelly/kevin-cogs/blob/main/dashboardplus/README.md
end_user_data_statement: Stores only listener enabled/bind/port and allowed hostnames in Red Config. Codes/session hashes, CSRF tokens, owner IDs and expiry times remain in bounded memory and expire/revoke on stop/unload/restart. No bot token, password, member database copy or web access history is saved. Owners see reviewed settings and public track metadata; source cogs retain their own data/audit policies. User-data hooks export credential-free transient login counts and revoke that user's logins.
